_comment: What 'the same text' means, pinned for every implementation: prepora_pipeline/dedupe/normalize.py and its TypeScript ports (packages/api/src/lib/review-dedupe.ts, packages/content/src/duplicates.ts). Generated by the Python implementation; a change here is a change to every stored content_hash (bump NORMALIZATION_VERSION). Text is kept to the Basic Multilingual Plane: outside it the JS hash iterates UTF-16 units and diverges.
